scope.production: next/src/**/*.ts, including declarations and contracts; all present files, tracked or untracked
scope.contracts: next/src/contracts/**/*.ts, a subset of production (do not add again)
scope.tests: next/tests/**/*.ts, including fixtures/helpers, matching the prior 56-file TypeScript baseline; not a test-case count
scope.supplementaryTestCode: non-TS authored test code reported separately so the mjs worker is not omitted or mixed into the prior TypeScript comparison
scope.physicalLines: CRLF/CR/LF-delimited rows; empty file = 0; no extra row for a terminal newline; comments and blank lines included
scope.excludedFromPrimaryCounts: README/docs, frozen Kernel/vendor, scripts/resources, dependencies and generated dist are not platform production/test TypeScript

prior.source: Parent-confirmed previous verified-target measurement; physical-line totals are supplied values, not derivable from hash-only manifest

integrity.method: Read and hash both target source/test trees and all protected original roots twice; compare contents/path sets and baseline evidence bytes before writing this result

limitations: This measures file size, not theoretical or behavioral complexity. Added capability/source lines are not evidence of reduced complexity.
No product tests, builds, or isolation checks were run by this metrics task; final acceptance is owned by the main reviewer.
Per-path comparison covers all regular files under next/src and next/tests; primary size counts select TypeScript only.
